title: 密閉式堆肥反應器
summary: 本課以「密閉堆肥的混料、供氧、散熱與成熟度證據」為主軸，依序處理可堆肥物與雜質驗收、含水率混合設計、需氧與送風分配、蒸發損失與補水、熟化速率與穩定度。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
summaryEn: This course focuses on Blend, oxygenate, cool and verify maturation in enclosed composting, progressing through Compostable feed and contamination, Moisture blending, Oxygen demand and air distribution, Evaporation and water replacement, Curing rate and stability. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.
scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 可堆肥物與雜質驗收：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Compostable feed and contamination: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 可堆肥物與雜質驗收 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Compostable feed and contamination and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 進料分選須辨認可分解有機物與不屬於堆肥產品的雜質，粉碎不等於去除污染。 分率必須以同一濕基或乾基定義；總質量乘分率才是該成分的質量。
steps.instructionEn: Receiving inspection separates compostable organics from product contaminants; shredding does not remove contamination. Fractions require a consistent wet or dry basis; multiplying total mass by its fraction gives component mass.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：總進料 m=1000 kg；目標成分質量分率 f=0.18。公式 m_target=m*f，計算得 180 kg。適用邊界：批次均勻且分樣具代表性；不把質量分率當體積分率。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Total feed m=1000 kg; target-component mass fraction f=0.18. Formula m_target=m*f gives 180 kg. Applicability: A homogeneous batch and representative sampling; mass fraction is not volume fraction.
steps.failure: 濕基與乾基混用會令回收物或負荷被高估。 在「可堆肥物與雜質驗收」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Mixing wet and dry bases overstates recovered material or loading. Mark where this error can enter the Compostable feed and contamination flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「可堆肥物與雜質驗收」，秤總樣與分離後成分，保存含水率與分樣方式，檢查回收率。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Compostable feed and contamination, Weigh the bulk sample and separated fraction; retain moisture basis and sampling procedure and check recovery. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只將 f 改成 0.22，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 180 變成 220 kg。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
knowledge.textEn: Change only f to 0.22, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 180 to 220 kg. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「密閉式堆肥反應器」的「可堆肥物與雜質驗收：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出污染或資源來源、處理單元、回收與排放的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「資源循環物料站」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與配對採樣位置、濃度、流量、時間與品質旗標的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Compostable feed and contamination: Mechanism and observation” in “In-vessel composting reactors”. Draw the source, treatment, recovery and discharge boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Circular-resource material station” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for paired sampling locations, concentrations, flows, times and quality flags, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

steps.title: 碳氮總量配料：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Carbon-nitrogen blend accounting: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 碳氮總量配料 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Carbon-nitrogen blend accounting and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 將木質調理料與含氮廚餘逐批分析；總碳氮比需與實際可利用碳一起解讀。 混合碳氮比由碳總質量除以氮總質量；各原料碳氮比的算術平均一般不成立。
steps.instructionEn: Analyze woody bulking material and nitrogen-rich food waste by batch; interpret total C:N alongside available carbon. A blend C:N ratio is total carbon divided by total nitrogen; an arithmetic mean of feedstock ratios is generally invalid.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：原料 A：C=30 kg、N=2 kg；原料 B：C=50 kg、N=0.5 kg。公式 C_to_N=(CA+CB)/(NA+NB)，計算得 32 kg C/kg N。適用邊界：元素總量基準，未區分可生物利用性；數值不是配方建議。
